explanation.text: The claimed population of 5,290,000 for New Zealand at midyear 2024 is supported by official provisional data from Statistics New Zealand.
Statistics New Zealand reports the base population as 5.290 million (provisional) at 30 June 2024, aligning with the claimed figure and timeframe.
An additional authoritative source, Statistics New Zealand via Infoshare, lists the estimated resident population for the year ended June 2024 as exactly 5,290,000.
Midyear 2024 corresponds to 30 June 2024, which matches the date used in the cited population estimates.
Both sources are authoritative records published by Statistics New Zealand, confirming the reliability of the population figure.
The claim is therefore supported as written, with exact numerical and temporal alignment to official provisional data.
